mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 59 degrees. The moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase, and if you look up at 3:25 AM, you can catch the International Space Station crossing from the west southwest over Mount Horeb toward Madison near the Home Depot.
Checking in on the latest from city hall, there are no new emails or major news stories reported, meaning it has been a fairly quiet start to the week.

We have a packed schedule of fun today and tomorrow. Today, join us for Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, there is plenty to do including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Reviewing the weekly police report from August 17 to August 24, we saw several traffic-related incidents. Notably, on August 19, there was a vehicle crash on North Main Street that resulted in minor injuries and citations for both drivers.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Since the restaurant is currently closed, you will have to wait until they open at 10:00 AM to get your fix.
